problem.p2: But many brides forget to take care of the most important person on that day: Themselves.

whyUs.title: Why Trust Your Relaxation to MJ Estética?
whyUs.desc: We understand the importance of your wedding. We don't just provide a service, we create a sanctuary of peace for you.

items.q: How far in advance should I book my Wedding Spa?
items.a: We recommend booking at least 2 to 4 weeks in advance to ensure your space in our calendar.

items.q: How many days before the wedding is ideal to perform the spa?
items.a: The ideal is between 2 and 5 days before the wedding. This way you will be relaxed and the aesthetic benefits on your skin will be at their peak on the day of the event.

items.q: Can my bridesmaids or mom come?
items.a: Of course! We can coordinate a group experience so you can share this moment with your closest people.

items.q: Do you have packages that include facials?
items.a: Yes, our star package 'Radiant Bride' includes a facial specifically designed to provide immediate luminosity.

items.q: What should I bring on the day of my session?
items.a: Just your willingness to relax. We provide everything you need: robe, slippers and a courtesy drink.
